title: Thornbury
about: A market town to explore: shop, rest at the inn, visit the temple, and take on work from the townsfolk.

wolves.title: Wolves at the Woods' Edge
wolves.offer: Wolves have been taking sheep at the edge of the woods, a mile east. Put an end to it and the town pays 40 gold.
wolves.done: Captain Reyes nods. 'Good work. The shepherds will sleep tonight.'

kit.title: A Kit for the Temple
kit.offer: Our healer's kit is spent, and the market's prices are beyond the temple. Could you bring us one?
kit.done: Sister Maren blesses you and gives you a potion from the temple stores.

square.name: Thornbury Market
square.text: A busy market square. Stalls sell everything from rope to longswords, and the Thorn and Thistle inn does a roaring trade. The temple's bell tower rises to the north; the east gate leads to the woods.

temple.name: The Temple of the Dawn
temple.text: A quiet temple of pale stone, scented with incense.

gate.name: The East Gate
gate.text: The town's east gate, watched by a captain of the guard.

people.name: Captain Reyes
people.text: A weathered captain of the guard.

woods.name: The Woods' Edge
woods.text: Tangled undergrowth at the edge of the woods. Tufts of wool hang on the brambles, and something growls.
